descriptions.run: Produce the Google Ads figures report for one registered client: its three read-only reports, no AI analysis. Takes minutes. Returns a result with status ok|refused|failed|busy, or pending with a request_id. A refused or failed result is FINAL: do not call this tool again for that client today.
descriptions.list: List the timestamps of a client's past figures reports. Returns timestamps only.
descriptions.status: Check the result of an earlier report request by its request_id. Files nothing.
